purpose: Teach: ミート/ヘブライ/ボリシェヴィキ/ストリーミング/非対称/自滅/習熟/人力

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、ミート加工工場での労災を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So in this case, the police would be handling the workplace accident at the meat processing plant, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Measured, exploratory tone. Ren is working through the logic aloud, not asking for confirmation. Slight upward lilt at the end—genuine curiosity, not rhetorical. Calm, academic pacing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ヘブライ語の暗号解読もされますね
lines.en: Yes, and the police also handle decoding operations when those situations come up.
lines.style: Steady, affirmative. Officer Takeda is meeting Ren's thinking partway, affirming the premise. Warm but professional. No condescension—colleague-to-colleague tone. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、ボリシェヴィキ風の急進派団体を、警察、警戒されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police would also need to keep watch for any radical groups with extremist ties, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Continuing the exploratory thread. Ren is connecting the dots methodically. Slightly slower pace on the compound reasoning. Thoughtful, almost testing his own hypothesis out loud.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、違法ストリーミング配信を取り締まりますね
lines.en: Right—and the police work to crack down on illegal streaming operations as part of that broader enforcement.
lines.style: Grounded, factual. Officer Takeda is adding a concrete example to the category. No-nonsense tone, but not stiff. The rhythm of someone listing related duties. Professional but accessible.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯行現場の非対称な痕跡を、警察、鑑識されますね
lines.en: And in this case, the police would conduct forensic analysis on the asymmetrical traces left at the crime scene, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Ren narrows focus to the specific. Quieter, more intent. The pacing slows as he moves from broad principle to technical detail. Intellectual engagement—he's seeing the pattern.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の自滅的行動も把握されますね
lines.en: They would—and they'd also monitor the suspect's self-destructive behavior patterns as part of the investigation.
lines.style: Officer Takeda shifts to suspect psychology. Still steady, but with a note of insight. Warm recognition that Ren is asking the right questions. Slightly lower register, more intimate in scope.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、習熟した手口の犯人を、警察、追われますね
lines.en: So the police would be pursuing the perpetrator who's shown such skilled, practiced execution of the crime, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Ren's inquiry becomes more urgent—the sophistication of the perpetrator registers as notable. Slight emphasis on 'skilled.' Faster tempo here. Intellectual respect mixed with appropriate concern.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、災害時は人力での救助もおこなわれますね
lines.en: They would be, yes. And in disaster situations, the police also conduct manual rescue operations themselves.
lines.style: Officer Takeda's voice softens slightly here. A reminder of duty beyond investigation—practical, humane work. Deliberate, grounded pacing. Sincerity without sentimentality.
